sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Disable telemetry
Turns off Samsung Analytics, crash reports, usage surveys and marketing data.
Enable non-One UI ROM support
Makes Samsung Notes installable and usable on non-One UI ROMs.
Import and export notes
Adds Import notes and Export notes (.sdocx files) to Settings.
Remove Google services
Starts Firebase only for Samsung Cloud sync and removes the Play review prompt and Google Meet sharing.
Samsung account sign-in
Signs in to your Samsung account on Samsung's web page to sync with Samsung Cloud (experimental).

sources.label: Morphe patches that run Samsung Notes on non-Samsung devices, with pen button ac
sources.author: Jibon's Notes
patch_list: Backup to folder
Adds a Local backup row to the bottom of the side menu: backs up changed notes as .sdocx files to a folder you choose (any folder, including SD card or a synced folder).
Branding
Your own app name, the Notes pen logo as launcher icon, and an accent colour in place of Samsung's blue.
Crash fixes

Reports no iris scanner, makes Share (PDF, image, Word...) open the app chooser, and finds the pen settings layouts, colour palettes and share provider after a package rename, and keeps Samsung Cloud sync from crashing on Samsung phones.
Finger drawing
Turns off "S Pen only" by default (once, at first start), so fingers can draw and scroll. Without it, the app assumes an S Pen and ignores finger input in notes.
Folder sync
Experimental. Syncs notes with other devices through a shared folder (for example one kept in sync by Syncthing): "Sync now" in the Local backup menu, and automatically each time the app opens.
Hide camera
Removes Insert > Camera from the editor.
Hide Samsung account features
Hides Samsung Cloud sync, sign-in, sharing, Galaxy AI and note locking.
Manifest compatibility
Makes One UI-only libraries optional (otherwise the install fails), gives foreground services a type (Android 14+ crashes without one) and drops multiArch.
Pen button actions

Lets the pen's two buttons run actions (pen, eraser, undo, colour picker, page up/down...) with single, double and long press. Set up in Settings > Pen button actions. Works with pens whose buttons send key presses (the Redmi Smart Pen sen…
Samsung account sign-in
Signs in to your Samsung account on Samsung's web page to sync with Samsung Cloud, also on Samsung phones, where the Samsung Account app doesn't serve a patched Notes.
Samsung framework compatibility
Adds stand-ins for One UI framework classes and redirects calls to One UI-only methods and fields, so the app runs on non-Samsung Android.
System file picker
Opens the system file picker, which also lists the other file managers, wherever Notes needs Samsung My Files: Insert PDF, audio and text files, Import notes, Save as file and export.
Treat as pen device
Turns on the app's pen features (pen toolbar, hover) on a device with an active pen that isn't a Samsung S Pen. Leave it off on devices without an active pen.
Turn off Samsung cloud components
Turns off the Samsung account, cloud sync, push and co-editing services. Samsung Cloud sync stops working.
Turn off telemetry
Turns off Samsung Analytics, crash reports, usage surveys and marketing uploads, the Play review prompt, Google Meet sharing and Google Sign-In, and starts Firebase only if Samsung sync uses it.
